### Guidance to Solomon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/guidance-to-solomon
Passage: 1 Kings 2:1-9
Points:
- David urged Solomon to display courage and decisiveness in order to lead the nation and secure the throne.
- Earthly strength and political acumen are futile without wholehearted obedience to the law of God.
- The enduring promise to David's royal lineage ultimately pointed forward to the perfect obedience of Christ.
- Though ultimate blessing rests on Christ's righteousness, faithful daily obedience remains vital for believers.
